SELECT sub.REGIST_SEQNO as registSeqno, POS.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, STR_TO_DATE(#{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') as posDate, sub.PLAN_ASSET_ID as planAssetId, sub.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, POS.TOTAL_NUM as totalNum, POS.ISSUE_AMT as issueAmt, POS.UNINVEST_CASH as uninvestCash, POS.POS_NUM as posNum, POS.POS_AMT as posAmt, '02' status FROM CHB_BOT_AST_POS_SUB sub LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO PLANASSET ON IFNULL(PLANASSET.ASSET_CODE_OLD , PLANASSET.ASSET_CODE) = sub.PLAN_ASSET_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO BOTASSET ON IFNULL(BOTASSET.ASSET_CODE_OLD , BOTASSET.ASSET_CODE) = sub.ASSET_CODE left join CHB_BOT_AST_POS POS on SUB.POS_DATE = POS.POS_DATE and POS.PLAN_ASSET_ID = PLANASSET.ASSET_CODE and POS.ASSET_CODE = BOTASSET.ASSET_CODE and POS.status in ('M','E')
left join data_auth_notify_inst dis on (dis.business_id=sub.PLAN_ASSET_ID or dis.business_id='F28_'||sub.PLAN_ASSET_ID) and dis.model_type = '02' AND dis.DATA_TYPE in ('FINASSET12','PTL01')
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(sub.POS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') and SUB.STATUS <>'03' and ((POS.POS_NUM is not null and SUB.POS_NUM <> POS.POS_NUM) or (POS.TOTAL_NUM is not null and SUB.TOTAL_NUM <> POS.TOTAL_NUM) or (POS.ISSUE_AMT is not null and SUB.ISSUE_AMT <> POS.ISSUE_AMT) or (POS.UNINVEST_CASH is not null and SUB.UNINVEST_CASH <> POS.UNINVEST_CASH) or (POS.POS_AMT is not null and SUB.POS_AMT <> POS.POS_AMT))
and dis.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
union all SELECT sub.REGIST_SEQNO as registSeqno, sub.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, STR_TO_DATE(#{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') as posDate, sub.PLAN_ASSET_ID as planAssetId, sub.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, sub.TOTAL_NUM as totalNum, sub.ISSUE_AMT as issueAmt, sub.UNINVEST_CASH as uninvestCash, sub.POS_NUM as posNum, sub.POS_AMT as posAmt, '03' status FROM CHB_BOT_AST_POS_SUB sub LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO PLANASSET ON IFNULL(PLANASSET.ASSET_CODE_OLD , PLANASSET.ASSET_CODE) = sub.PLAN_ASSET_ID LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO BOTASSET ON IFNULL(BOTASSET.ASSET_CODE_OLD , BOTASSET.ASSET_CODE) = sub.ASSET_CODE
left join data_auth_notify_inst dis on (dis.business_id=sub.PLAN_ASSET_ID or dis.business_id='F28_'||sub.PLAN_ASSET_ID) and dis.model_type = '02' AND dis.DATA_TYPE in ('FINASSET12','PTL01')
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(sub.POS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') and SUB.STATUS <>'03'
and dis.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and not exists ( select 1 from CHB_BOT_AST_POS POS where DATE_FORMAT(SUB.POS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(POS.POS_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') and PLANASSET.ASSET_CODE = POS.PLAN_ASSET_ID and BOTASSET.ASSET_CODE = POS.ASSET_CODE and POS.STATUS != 'D')
